description: Local PostgreSQL 16 plus MinIO import-flow drill for a database connection outage after exact-version fetch, parse, seal and independent verification but before atomic Preview commit. The failed commit must leave no durable Preview rows, preserve sealed spool evidence, and a new spool attempt for the same source and Preview ID must commit exactly once after connectivity returns. This is not database process loss, replication failover, PITR or production evidence.
requiredAssertions: source object is uploaded and bound before the database outage is injected
parse, seal and independent verification complete before the unreachable commit pool fails
failed commit leaves zero preview_ready rows and keeps the import job in preview_building
failed commit preserves one sealed spool attempt for investigation or later processing
recovery uses the same source and Preview ID with a new spool attempt
recovery commits exactly one Preview, two candidates and one rejection
first successful recovery is not mislabeled as an idempotent replay
limitations: unreachable commit pool rather than stopping the PostgreSQL process
not replication failover, leader promotion or connection-pool failover
source fetch and parse dependencies remain healthy
recovery uses a new spool attempt rather than resuming commit directly from the preserved sealed spool
not PITR, cross-cluster or production chaos evidence
